method.timed_region: begin, all puts, durable commit outcome
method.verification: close, reopen, byte-compare every key, participant SHA-256, harness SHA-256
method.comparison_batching: shared logical iteration count with balanced pair order
method.resumption: Each pair is sealed immediately with its request, collection-time identity, and raw hashes. A resumed campaign accepts only byte-identical sealed pairs under the same campaign identity.
method.in_process_adapter_note: Each batch uses an in-process engine adapter and a fresh database. Setup, close, reopen, and verification are visible as harness wall time but excluded from primary_time.
